acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four items is corrected in the spec or packet with a vector where behaviour differs (deletion same-path case), REQUIREMENTS.tsv regenerated.
body:
Panel finding (wire lens), confirmed at the cited lines on f8ea0758e.
1. docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md:301 defines samePathCitations against the hunk's post-image path; both consumers use the old path for a pure deletion (internal/cem/verify/support.go:255-258, interop uses the map path). A literal implementer counts 0 on deletions; no vector covers it.
2. CEM-V1-080 text (cem-stable-v1.md:265-267) still says the tier is computed on cem/0.2 or 0.3 maps after the cutover.
3. interop/cem01-go/testdata/citation/README.md:9 says the sealed stable result does not carry the block, contradicting CEM-V1-092 (cem-stable-v1.md:318).
4. The hunk `path` rule (old path for a deletion) exists only in code (internal/cem/patch, verify.go:307), not in the contract.

Version: origin/main f8ea0758ee1b77bb45931818e47ae1a9a95d1d59 (2026-10-13). Panel evidence (scratch, not retained in-tree): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/b89960c8-2163-4353-8ea9-7b6117332c1b/scratchpad/panel/<lens>/.
title: cem-stable-v1 drift: samePathCitations path rule, CEM-V1-080 spec names, citation testdata README
